hypothesis.statement: In the UCI Parkinson's Telemonitoring cohort (42 patients, ~5875 visits), a random-intercept mixed model total_UPDRS ~ test_time + age + sex + PPE + (1|subject) reproduces lme4::lmer to machine precision, with a positive test_time slope (progression over ~6 months).

analysis_plan.dataset: UCI Parkinson's Telemonitoring (Tsanas et al. 2010), 42 early-stage PD patients, 5875 voice recordings over ~6 months

decision.threshold: descriptive: test_time fixed-effect slope (UPDRS points/day); > 0 = progression
